Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, favor me with the survival of my children
And with their righteousness for me, and with my enjoyment of them
My God, extend for me their lifespans
And increase for me their terms
And nurture for me their little ones
And strengthen for me their weak ones
And make sound for me their bodies, their faith, and their character
And grant them well-being in themselves and in their faculties

Arabic text: وَفِيْ كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ
Translation: And in all that concerns me regarding their affairs
And increase for me and by my hands their sustenance
And make them righteous, God-fearing, insightful, and attentive
Obedient to You and to Your friends, loving and sincere
And to all Your enemies, resistant and hateful. Amen
O Allah, strengthen my support through them

Arabic text: وَأَقِمْ بِهِمْ أَوَدِي، وَكَثِّرْ بِهِمْ عَدَدِي
Translation: And straighten my crookedness through them, and increase my numbers through them

Arabic text: وَزَيِّنْ بِهِمْ مَحْضَرِي، وَأَحْيِ بِهِمْ ذِكْرِي
Translation: And adorn my presence through them, and keep my memory alive through them

Arabic text: وَاكْفِنِيْ بِهِمْ فِيْ غَيْبَتِيْ وَأَعِنِّيْ بِهِمْ عَلَى حَاجَتِي
Translation: And suffice me through them in my absence, and help me through them with my needs

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِيْ مُحِبِّينَ، وَعَلَيَّ حَدِبِينَ مُقْبِلِينَ مُسْتَقِيمِيْنَ لِي
Translation: And make them loving towards me, affectionate to me, approaching me, and upright for me
Obedient, not disobedient

Arabic text: وَلَا عَاقِّينَ وَلَا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلَا خَاطِئِينَ
Translation: Not disrespectful, not opposing, and not erring
And help me in their upbringing, their discipline, and being dutiful to them

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاَدًا ذُكُورًا
Translation: And grant me from Your presence, with them, male children

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرًا لِيْ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِيْ عَوْنًا عَلَى مَا سَأَلْتُكَ
Translation: And make that good for me, and make them for me a support in what I ask of You
And protect me and my offspring from the accursed Satan
For indeed You created us, commanded us, forbade us, and made us desire

Arabic text: فِيْ ثَوَابِ مَا أَمَرْتَنَا وَرَهَّبْتَنَا عِقَابَهُ
Translation: The reward of what You commanded us, and made us fear its punishment
And You made for us an enemy who plots against us

Arabic text: سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ
Translation: You gave him power over us in ways You did not give us power over him
You settled him in our chests, and made him run in our blood vessels

Arabic text: لَا يَغْفُلُ إِنْ غَفَلْنَا، وَلَا يَنْسَى إِنْ نَسِينَا
Translation: He does not become heedless when we are heedless, and does not forget when we forget
He makes us feel secure from Your punishment, and frightens us with other than You
If we intend to commit an indecency, he encourages us to do it

Arabic text: وَإِنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ ثَبَّطَنَا عَنْهُ
Translation: And if we intend to do a righteous deed, he holds us back from it

Arabic text: يَتَعَرَّضُ لَنَا بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَيَنْصِبُ لَنَا بِالشُّبُهَاتِ
Translation: He presents us with desires, and sets up for us doubts

Arabic text: إِنْ وَعَدَنَا كَذَبَنَا وَإِنْ مَنَّانَا أَخْلَفَنَا
Translation: If he promises us, he lies to us, and if he gives us hope, he breaks his promise
And if You do not turn his plot away from us, he will lead us astray
And if You do not protect us from his corruption, he will cause us to slip

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَاقْهَرْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا بِسُلْطَانِكَ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا
Translation: O Allah, subdue his authority over us with Your authority until You restrain him from us

Arabic text: بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ، فَنُصْبِحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِيْ الْمَعْصُومِيْنَ بِكَ
Translation: Through abundant supplication to You, so that we may become, through Your protection, safe from his plots

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِيْ كُلَّ سُؤْلِي، وَاقْضِ لِيْ حَوَائِجِي
Translation: O Allah, grant me all my requests, and fulfill for me my needs

Arabic text: وَلَا تَمْنَعْنِيْ الْإِجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي
Translation: And do not withhold the response from me when You have guaranteed it to me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَحْجُبْ دُعَائِيْ عَنْكَ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنِيْ بِهِ
Translation: And do not veil my supplication from You when You have commanded me to make it
And favor me with all that benefits me

Arabic text: فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِيْ مَا ذَكَرْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا نَسِيتُ
Translation: In my worldly life and my hereafter, what I have remembered of it and what I have forgotten

Arabic text: أَوْ أَظْهَرْتُ أَوْ أَخْفَيْتُ، أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَوْ أَسْرَرْتُ
Translation: Or what I have shown or concealed, or what I have made public or kept secret

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ ذٰلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِيْنَ بِسُؤَالِيْ إِيَّاكَ
Translation: And make me in all of that among those who are reformed by asking You
Those who are successful in seeking from You
Those who are not denied by relying upon You

Arabic text: اَلْمُعَوَّدِيْنَ بِالتَّعَوُّذِ بِكَ، اَلرَّابِحِيْنَ فِيْ التِّجَارَةِ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُجَارِينَ بِعِزِّكَ
Translation: Those accustomed to seeking refuge in You, those who profit in trading with You, those protected by Your might
Those upon whom lawful sustenance is expanded
From Your vast bounty through Your generosity and nobility

Arabic text: اَلْمُعَزِّينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ بِكَ، وَالْمُجَارِينَ مِنَ الظُّلْمِ بِعَدْلِكَ
Translation: Those who are honored from humiliation by You, and those who are protected from injustice by Your justice

Arabic text: وَالْمُعَافَيْنَ مِنَ الْبَلاَءِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَالْمُغْنَيْنَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ بِغِنَاكَ
Translation: And those who are saved from affliction by Your mercy, and those who are enriched from poverty by Your wealth

Arabic text: وَالْمَعْصُومِيْنَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ
Translation: And those who are preserved from sins, errors, and mistakes by Your fear
And those who are guided to goodness, right guidance, and correctness by Your obedience
And those who are prevented from sins by Your power

Arabic text: اَلتَّارِكِينَ لِكُلِّ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، اَلسَّاكِنِيْنَ فِيْ جِوَارِكَ
Translation: Those who abandon all disobedience to You, those who dwell in Your proximity
O Allah, give us all of that through Your guidance
And Your mercy, and protect us from the punishment of the blazing fire
And grant all Muslim men and women

Arabic text: وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِثْلَ الَّذِيْ سَأَلْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
Translation: And believing men and women the like of what I have asked You for myself

Arabic text: وَلِوُلْدِيْ فِيْ عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَ آجِلِ الْآخِرَةِ
Translation: And for my children in the immediate world and the future hereafter
Indeed, You are Near, Responsive, All-Hearing, All-Knowing
Pardoning, Forgiving, Kind, Merciful

Arabic text: وَ آتِنَا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِيْ الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
Translation: And give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire
